title: A units or Lp(a)-unit change mid-run is not a save-all stop cause; every later values report repeats the refusal
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/LabUpload/LabReportSave.swift:203 stop() checks only the erase and an unreadable record; ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:409 (units changed) and :413 (Lp(a) unit) refuse each later save the same way. Adversary F3 on save all (US-52 AC8b), 2026-11-11
